Name: CleanBeach
Author: Artinity
Description:
If you are the type of player that likes to keep their entire map neat and tidy, you have probably wished once or twice that you could clean up that unreachable trash on the beaches south and southwest of the Cindersap forest, near the sewer entrance and the Hat Mouse. Wish no more! This mod does just that.

[i]Note: This mod is compatible with Trash Bear event in Year 3+. It basically saves the Trash Bear some work :)[/i]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Artinity/CleanBeach]Source code[/url]
[/list]
